title: NVDA: Earnings Call: Q2 2027
content: Q2 revenue hit a record $96B, more than doubling YoY, as data center demand surged. FY2028 revenue is expected to grow ~70%, but supply constraints and memory costs are set to pressure margins.

title: MRVL: Earnings Call: Q2 2027
content: Record Q2 revenue and EPS exceeded guidance, prompting a $500M FY27 and $1.5B FY28 revenue outlook increase. Data center and custom silicon drive growth, with new hyperscaler agreements and robust demand for AI infrastructure. Operating leverage and margins are set to expand.

title: MRVL: Citi’s 2026 Global TMT Conference
content: A decade-long pivot to data center and AI has driven explosive growth, with leadership in networking, optics, and custom silicon. The company is set for continued expansion, doubling custom sales next year and targeting $30B in two-year revenue, while maintaining strong operating margins and capital discipline.

title: MRVL: The Six Five Summit: AI Unleashed 2026
content: AI infrastructure is rapidly evolving, with connectivity emerging as the key bottleneck as compute and memory challenges are addressed. Strategic investments in photonics, memory expansion, and custom silicon position the company for leadership as the AI market enters early innings of massive growth and innovation.

title: AMD: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026
content: AI adoption has driven major productivity gains and accelerated product development, with a shift toward full rack-scale, system-level solutions and a strong focus on software. The company targets rapid growth in data center and AI revenue, leveraging a broad product portfolio and ecosystem leadership to capture expanding market opportunities.

title: AMD: Citi’s 2026 Global TMT Conference
content: AI-driven demand is accelerating, with inferencing now leading compute needs and a projected $2T AI market by 2030. Major product ramps, multi-generational customer partnerships, and robust supply chain investments are set to double data center revenue next year, while gross margin expansion is supported by a diverse product mix.

title: AMD: Technology Leadership Forum 2026
content: Server CPU and AI data center markets are experiencing unprecedented growth, with major product launches like Venice and Helios driving revenue and customer demand. Multi-gigawatt commitments from leading AI companies and significant software advancements in ROCm position the company for continued market share gains and innovation.

title: MU: Earnings Call: Q4 2026
content: Demand for memory products is accelerating through 2028, driven by AI and server growth, while supply remains structurally constrained due to slow cleanroom expansion and complex HBM transitions. Margin expansion and higher R&D spending are expected, with tight market conditions supporting strong financial performance.
